question: Does any published short-holding-period strategy, tested exactly as published on Binance USDT-M perpetuals at its natural timeframe, have a real edge after costs and funding, and at what leverage does it stay below a 5% probability of ruin?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-12 after the user removed the leverage veto (research only; no real orders) and asked for short holding periods across different timeframes. Gates G1-G8 are inherited from strategy-search-v2 (null-consistent deflated Sharpe, with N counting every trial in v1, v2 and v3: v1 contributes 9). Edge is judged at 1x; leverage is judged separately by ruin probability, because leverage scales an edge but cannot create one.

scope.timeframes: holding periods from 15 minutes to 3 days, tested at the candidate's own published bar interval (15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 1d)
scope.data: Binance USDT-M futures archive (data.binance.vision): klines at the needed interval, mark-price klines for liquidation checks, fundingRate history; delisted contracts included; free only
scope.eligible: explicit, codable rules with published parameters; crypto perpetual or applicable to it
scope.excluded: families already failed in this repo when tested at the SAME timeframe and universe (8h breakouts/mean reversion/session effects on the 10 old coins, funding carry, Fear & Greed, Kronos), grid/DCA/martingale (negative-skew ruin by construction), anything needing order-book replay, paid data, or real order placement

procedure.no_tuning: published parameters only; ambiguities resolved in a round registration before testing
procedure.rounds: research rounds of up to 8 candidates; stop at the first candidate passing every gate, at budget exhaustion, or after 3 rounds

costs.fees: Binance USDT-M taker 5 bps per side on every entry and exit (no maker assumption), plus 2 bps slippage per side; i.e. 14 bps round trip on notional, scaled by leverage
costs.funding: realized Binance funding on held notional at each settlement while a position is open
costs.samples: development = source sample truncated to data availability, else data start to 2022-12-31; validation = 2023-01-01 to 2026-09-30 minus development

gates_at_1x: G1-G8 exactly as strategy-search-v2 (G5 = review_methods.deflated_sharpe_null_consistent with cumulative N); annualization by calendar days (365) on daily-aggregated returns

leverage_assessment.liquidation: isolated margin per position; a position is liquidated when the adverse mark-price move within a bar (mark high/low) reaches 1/L minus the maintenance margin rate (0.5% for this study), losing its margin plus a 0.5% liquidation fee
leverage_assessment.ruin: account equity falling below 50% of its starting value at any point
leverage_assessment.statistic: probability of ruin within 365 days from a stationary block bootstrap of daily account returns at each leverage (mean block 10 days, 5000 paths, seed 20261012), computed on the validation sample
leverage_assessment.reported_max_safe_leverage: the largest tested L with ruin probability <= 5% and no liquidation events in the historical validation path

outcome.promising_prospect: passes G1-G8 at 1x AND has a max safe leverage >= 2; it is then registered as a descriptive paper forward watch at its max safe leverage (simulated only)
outcome.no_pass: report FAIL with the full ledger; no loosening of gates
